CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 21.04.2023 CRL.M.A. 10613/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3. The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 37/2018 under Sections 313/376 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Shahbad Dairy and all other consequential proceedings emanating thereform, including the chargesheet pending before the court of competent jurisdiction.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that by way of Memorandum of Settlement dated 18.03.2023, respondent no. 2 has no objection if the present FIR is quashed.
6. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
